words.gloss: even those who did not listen

literal: Those who listened captivating having the nature, even those who did not listen to desire speaking is speech.
translation: True speech has the quality to captivate those who listen, and to make even those who have not listened desire to hear it.
modern: கேட்டவர்களைத் தன்வயப்படுத்தும் தன்மையுடையதாகவும், கேட்காதவர்களும் கேட்க விரும்புமாறு பேசுவதே சிறந்த சொல்லாற்றல் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true power of speech. It states that effective speech must have two qualities. First, it must captivate and hold the attention of those who are already listening. Second, its reputation and appeal must be so strong that even those who have not yet heard it desire to listen. The word 'பிணிக்கும்' (binding) vividly describes how a good speaker holds the audience spellbound.
